public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerInitialize
public_apis.summary: Initializes the ack tracker's two QUIC_RANGE fields (PacketNumbersReceived, PacketNumbersToAck)
preconditions: Tracker must point to valid memory
postconditions: Both range fields initialized with their respective max sizes

public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerUninitialize
public_apis.summary: Frees resources for both range fields

public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerReset
public_apis.summary: Resets tracker state: counters, flags, ECN data, and both ranges
side_effects: Clears AckElicitingPacketsToAcknowledge, LargestPacketNumberAcknowledged, LargestPacketNumberRecvTime, AlreadyWrittenAckFrame, NonZeroRecvECN, ReceivedECN

public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerAddPacketNumber
public_apis.summary: Adds packet to received set for duplicate detection. Returns TRUE if duplicate.
postconditions: Packet added to PacketNumbersReceived range if not already present
public_apis.errors: Returns TRUE on duplicate or allocation failure

public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerDidHitReorderingThreshold
public_apis.summary: Checks if reordering threshold from draft-ietf-quic-frequence-10 Section 6.2 was hit
preconditions: Tracker must have been initialized, PacketNumbersToAck must have been populated
postconditions: Returns TRUE if gap exceeds threshold, FALSE otherwise

public_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerHasPacketsToAck
public_apis.summary: Returns TRUE if there are packets to ACK and ACK frame not already written

connection_dependent_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerAckPacket
connection_dependent_apis.summary: Adds packet to ACK list, handles ECN, may trigger immediate or delayed ACK
connection_dependent_apis.reason: Uses QuicAckTrackerGetPacketSpace->Connection for send flags, reorder stats, etc.

connection_dependent_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerAckFrameEncode
connection_dependent_apis.summary: Encodes ACK frame into packet builder
connection_dependent_apis.reason: Uses Builder->Connection and complex QUIC_PACKET_BUILDER interactions

connection_dependent_apis.name: QuicAckTrackerOnAckFrameAcked
connection_dependent_apis.summary: Handles acknowledgment of previously sent ACK frame
connection_dependent_apis.reason: Uses QuicAckTrackerGetPacketSpace->Connection for send state updates

invariants: PacketNumbersReceived and PacketNumbersToAck are valid QUIC_RANGE after init
AlreadyWrittenAckFrame == TRUE means no new packets since last frame write
NonZeroRecvECN == TRUE iff any ECN count > 0
